:::{#thm-double-negation}
#### Double negation

For a [proposition](#def-proposition) $P$,

$$
\neg \neg P \equiv P.
$$

:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

::: proof

By the definition of [not](#def-not), the [truth table](#def-truth-table) is:

| $P$ | $\neg P$ | $\neg \neg P$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | F | T |
| F | T | F |

The first and last columns match in both rows,
so the two sides are [logically equivalent](#def-logically-equivalent).

:::

:::
